description:
The Army Contracting Command - Rock Island (ACC-RI) is seeking sources for the manufacturing of 17,500 each of Canister Bodies for the M106 Grenade. This requirement is expected to result in a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contract for the procurement of non-commercial item, Canister Bodies, under NAICS 322219 -- Other Paperboard Container Manufacturing.

The Canister Bodies shall be in accordance with attachment 0001 - Drawing 13-19-1011C dated 4 March 2026. First article testing (FAT) will be required at a quantity of ten (10) each.  FAT samples shall be delivered 30 days after contract award. 

Inspection and Acceptance/Delivery of Canister Bodies FAT and production quantity will be done at Destination.

Freight on Board point is Destination to Pine Bluff Arsenal:

US Army, Pine Bluff

Arsenal Central Shipping Receiving Point (CSRP)

BLDG 53-990, 506th Street

Pine Bluff, Arkansas 71602

The Point of Contract (POC) for this action is contract specialist Austin Acree at austin.g.acree.civ@army.mil
